title: Shipping, Delivery and Charging Terms for FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions
content:
**Fulfilment and delivery.** FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions shipments leave from the Groveport, Ohio warehouse by UPS Ground and arrive in 2 business days. A signature is required on delivery only where the grade calls for one, and no grade does. Shipments go only to the subscriber's service address unless the grade allows a gift subscription, and no grade does.

**Reminder and full-year case.** A reminder email goes out 7 days before each ship date. A full-year case may be shipped at once where the grade offers one.

**Charging.** Charges are made on the ship date to the card on file, with Ohio sales tax at the delivery county rate.

| Grade | Warehouse | Carrier | Business days in transit | Signature | Ships to another address | Reminder email | Full-year case |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | Groveport, Ohio | UPS Ground | 2 | No | No | 7 days before | Yes |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | Groveport, Ohio | UPS Ground | 2 | No | No | 7 days before | Yes |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | Groveport, Ohio | UPS Ground | 2 | No | No | 7 days before | Yes |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | Groveport, Ohio | UPS Ground | 2 | No | No | 7 days before | No |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | Groveport, Ohio | UPS Ground | 2 | No | No | 7 days before | No |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | Groveport, Ohio | UPS Ground | 2 | No | No | 7 days before | No |

| Grade | When a shipment is charged | Payment method required | Sales tax |
|---|---|---|---|
| All six grades | On the ship date | Card on file | Ohio sales tax at the delivery county rate |

### Terms applied

- **Delivery address.** Because no grade allows a gift subscription, every FilterDirect shipment goes to the subscriber's own service address.
- **Signature.** No grade requires a signature on delivery.
- **Full-year case.** Available for FilterDirect Standard MERV 8, FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 and FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13; not available for the three Media Cabinet grades.
- **Reminder (hypothetical date).** For a shipment leaving on 5 June, the reminder email goes out on 29 May, 7 days before.
